policies.calibration: first two mature historical OOT months; unweighted fit; disjoint from policy month
policies.policy: third full historical OOT month; labels strictly before E; all scores count toward daily slots
policies.decision_time: calibrator and policy fitted/selected at E; not a deployed as-of-policy-month calibrator
policies.selection: feasible candidates: fewest full-batch alerts, known FP, raw AP, fixed order; none feasible: highest known recall then known FP, alerts, raw AP, fixed order
policies.fallback: if 30% recall infeasible under cap, threshold=0 maximizes recall; cap takes priority; report infeasible
policies.budget: floor(fraction * full eligible scored daily cohort); no carryover; unknown outcomes retain slots; small batches may have zero capacity
policies.batch_timing: day closes before ranking; up to one day wait after approval; not immediate per-order inference
policies.ranking: calibrated score descending, raw score descending, order_id ascending; threshold includes ties then daily top-K
policies.calibration_transfer: one pooled historical mapping transfers to E model; cannot guarantee probability calibration or recall of a new version
policies.coverage: historical denominator is valid eventually-delivered cohort, not every raw approved order; mature outcomes may be selectively observed
policies.evaluation_role: three previously inspected development months; later folds can use earlier months as historical data; not independent tests
policies.promotion: research only; existing defaults and all previous artifacts preserved

schedule.evaluation_role: previously inspected retrospective development month; never selection outcomes
schedule.transfer_caveat: Validation scores come from older monthly refits; one shared threshold transfers to the evaluation refit without a future recall guarantee.
